text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco harvests record 9.75 million tonnes of cereals.
- Political parties start meetings to discuss constitutional reform.
- Tough measures to curb immigration do not daunt Moroccans who still try to reach Europe via Spain in makeshift boats.
- Tourism needs to face real problems: state-owned airline fares still too high, nothing has been done to improve service in hotels and beggars and hustlers still bully visitors.
